info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Parking Reservations Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservation Status API provides real-time access to the current status of parking reservations. It enables users to query the status of their reservations efficiently, supporting operations like monitoring and managing their parking needs. This API is particularly useful for parking managers and application developers who integrate parking functionalities into their systems. With clear and concise responses, users can enhance their applications' user experience by providing timely updates on reservation statuses.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of a reservation.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to check the status of a specific reservation. You can see whether the reservation is confirmed, pending, or canceled, providing you with real-time information about your booking.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of reservations. It should include any necessary filters or criteria to specify which reservations are being queried.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current status of reservations.

ListParkingReservationsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body expected in the application/json format for the GET operation on reservations status. It accepts a string value.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the reservation.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the response.

ListParkingReservationsStatusResponse_20.description: Response schema for the status of reservations after a GET operation.

createdBy.description: The user who created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Information about the audit trail for the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time in milliseconds spent processing the request. A value of 0 signifies that no additional processing time was required.
